snippet.title: Ascendora - Teaser | First-person horror, free demo on Steam
snippet.description:
A stormy night. A forest road. An abandoned laboratory at the end of it.

Harper, the child of a missing scientist, follows the road to Ascendora, where the answers are said to lie. The power is dead, the lantern's batteries are running low, and Harper might not be alone in there.

Ascendora is made by Beepy Games, an indie studio from Bedum, the Netherlands.

#Ascendora #HorrorGame #IndieHorror
